bullets.text: In Thiruvallur, heavy rain from Cyclone Murasu caused sudden waterlogging as reported by Sun News, and the office should monitor drainage operations.

In Pallikaranai near Kamatchi Hospital, a traffic jam trapped an ambulance during light rain, and the office must ensure better traffic management.
In Tiruvallur, liquor sales were barred within 5 km of the Andhra Pradesh border ahead of Chittoor polls, and the office should monitor compliance.
In Tiruvallur, the Avadi expressway path to the ration shop was severely damaged by rain, and the office must expedite repair works for residents.
In Ponneri, Nelcast is boosting its plant capacity to 60,000 TPA by January 2027, and the office should support necessary power supply upgrades.
In Chennai, Vultr plans to build 1 GW of AI compute capacity by 2029, and the office should facilitate regional data-centre expansion initiatives.
In Chennai, Vyoma.AI broke ground on a 52 MW AI-ready data center, and the office should track digital infrastructure milestones closely.
MeitY launched the DEPA handbook to support safe data sharing for AI training, and the office should review secure data protocols for state programs.
In Chennai, Aavin invited applications from interested individuals to run new milk parlays by November 16, and the office should promote local entrepreneurship.

stories.snippet: சென்னையில் புதிய ஆவின் (AAVIN) பாலகங்களை நடத்துவதற்கு ஆர்வமுள்ளவர்களிடமிருந்து விண்ணப்பங்கள் வரவேற்கப்படுகின்றன.நவம்பர் 16ஆம் தேதிக்குள் சமர்ப்பிக்க ஆவின் நிறுவனம் கேட்டுக்கொண்டுள்ளது. இதற்கான விண்ணப்பப் படிவங்களை ஆவின்…
